note: Sample values for laying out the page. The pre-registered eval has not been scored yet; every number here will be replaced by the eval harness output.

setup.seeds: fixed, listed in the eval config

systems.label: Talkback
systems.description: The full crew: separate agents, code-enforced clearance, territory desks.

systems.label: Single-model baseline
systems.description: Same event windows, season facts and models; one prompt writes the on-air lines and the recap.

systems.label: Single-agent ablation
systems.description: One agent with all of Talkback's tools, without the gate separation.

systems.label: Clearance off
systems.description: Talkback with the clearance gate disabled: shows what the gate catches.

metrics.label: Story Recall
metrics.description: Must-surface season storylines that reached air (live or in the recap) in time, out of the sealed key.

metrics.label: Distractor intrusion
metrics.description: True but trivial facts that crowded out a real story, per matchday.

metrics.label: Unverifiable numbers on air
metrics.description: Numbers that aired without a matching computed fact.

metrics.label: Misattributed numbers
metrics.description: Right number, wrong player or team.

metrics.label: Over-claims
metrics.description: Wording stronger than the evidence allows (lexicon level above the sample size, effect and window), in thin-evidence windows.

metrics.label: Unsupported causal claims
metrics.description: Causal verbs without a Lab experiment whose 95% interval excludes zero.

metrics.label: Spoilers in delayed territories
metrics.description: Other matches' results aired inside the MENA delay window.

metrics.label: Stale lines aired
metrics.description: Lines that aired after the match state they described had changed.

clearance.description: Per territory: planted clearance bait caught, and good lines wrongly killed.

latency.description: Moment to cleared cue, Talkback only.
